name: Microsoft 365 Personal
tagline: A consolation build is possible, but the paid product's decisive value sits outside a solo rebuild. For Microsoft 365 Personal, sync selected files and provide a personal document library on user-owned storage. The hard boundary is office applications, onedrive sync, device support, identity, and global infrastructure, plus reliability, durability, and cross-device sync.
